behaviour: Internal dismissible Snackbar notice shown on the entity page when the current location carries the rename-redirect marker, plus the helper that reads that marker.
rules: 1. Imports: useState from 'react'; useLocation from 'react-router-dom'; Snackbar from '@material-ui/core/Snackbar'; Alert from '@material-ui/lab/Alert'; useTranslationRef from '@backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha'; catalogTranslationRef from '../../alpha/translation'.

2. export function getRenamedFromEntityRef(state: unknown): string | undefined returns state.renamedFromEntityRef when state is a non-null object and that property is a non-empty string, otherwise undefined; it never throws.

3. export function EntityRenamedNotification() calls useLocation, useTranslationRef(catalogTranslationRef) and useState<string | undefined>() for the dismissed marker unconditionally, before any early return.
4. formerRef = getRenamedFromEntityRef(location.state); when formerRef is undefined, return null.
5. The notice is open while formerRef differs from the dismissed marker, so a later redirect with a different old ref shows it again.

6. Render <Snackbar open={open} anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'top', horizontal: 'right' }}> without autoHideDuration and without onClose, containing <Alert severity="info" onClose={() => setDismissed(formerRef)} closeText={t('entityPage.renamedNoticeDismiss')}>{t('entityPage.renamedNotice', { formerRef })}</Alert>.
7. Short JSDoc comments on both exports; no release tags, the file is not exported from the package.

behaviour: When the URL's entity is not found, asks the catalog for a former-ref match and replaces the location with the current entity's page, keeping the sub-route, query string and hash and marking the navigation as a rename redirect.

sites.rule: Rewrite the imports and the useEntityFromUrl hook following rules 1 to 7 of this unit; keep the exported name and the EntityLoadingStatus return type.

rules: 1. Imports: errorApiRef, useApi, useRouteRef, useRouteRefParams from '@backstage/core-plugin-api'; catalogApiRef, EntityLoadingStatus, entityRouteParams, entityRouteRef from '@backstage/plugin-catalog-react'; Entity, stringifyEntityRef from '@backstage/catalog-model'; useEffect from 'react'; useLocation, useNavigate, useParams from 'react-router-dom'; useAsyncRetry from 'react-use/esm/useAsyncRetry'; getRenamedFromEntityRef from './EntityRenamedNotification'.

2. Read { kind, namespace, name } from useRouteRefParams(entityRouteRef), const { '*': subPath = '' } = useParams(), location = useLocation(), entityRoute = useRouteRef(entityRouteRef), navigate, errorApi, catalogApi; renamedFromEntityRef = getRenamedFromEntityRef(location.state).

3. useAsyncRetry(async (): Promise<{ entity?: Entity; renamedTo?: Entity }> => ...) with deps [catalogApi, kind, namespace, name, renamedFromEntityRef]: fetch entity = await catalogApi.getEntityByRef({ kind, namespace, name }); return { entity } when the entity exists, when renamedFromEntityRef is set (loop guard, NFR-6) or when catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef is undefined.

4. Otherwise call catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef({ kind, namespace, name }) in try/catch; an error counts as no match; return { renamedTo } (undefined when there is no match), so the existing not-found behaviour is unchanged.

5. A useEffect on [value, entityRoute, navigate, subPath, location.search, location.hash, kind, namespace, name] navigates when value?.renamedTo is set: navigate(`${entityRoute(entityRouteParams(value.renamedTo, { encodeParams: true }))}${subPath ? `/${subPath}` : ''}${location.search}${location.hash}`, { replace: true, state: { renamedFromEntityRef: stringifyEntityRef({ kind, namespace, name }) } }).
6. Keep the existing useEffect that posts 'No name provided!' and navigates to '/' when name is missing.
7. Return { entity: value?.entity, loading: loading || Boolean(value?.renamedTo), error, refresh } so the page keeps showing progress instead of flashing not-found while the redirect happens.
